verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a WebRTC media server, but nothing in the evidence documents TCP, TLS/TURN, or WebSocket media fallback when UDP is blocked, or when such a fallback engages. The ports/firewall item only says UDP can be handled on a single port. The Twilio-over-websockets item is a telephony connector, not a media transport fallback.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, a stream survives a network that blocks UDP: the service documents fallback over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket and when it engages
